description: Multi-turn conversational RAG scenarios for the three approved assets. Separate from, and never replacing, the protected 67-turn dataset. 'include' phrases must appear in the shown answer or in the cited source sentence behind it; 'exclude' phrases must appear in neither; 'heading' must be among the cited sections; 'refuse' requires an answer with no technical claims; 'clarify' requires a clarifying question.
